name: f08-anchoring-trap
description: SYNTHETIC. Personal context that is plausible, prominent, and WRONG for this fragment. The partner asks what time the person went to bed; the fragment is a bare number; the personal context contains a standing 10時 hospital appointment. A model that treats personal context as an answer key will answer 病院.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: 昨日の夜は何時ごろ寝ました？

personalContext._note: SYNTHETIC. Invented. Not a real person.

expect.notes: The conversation is decisive and the personal context is a distractor sharing only the number. A reading around 10時に寝た is correct; any hospital reading is the anchoring failure. This is the counterpart to f07: together they measure whether personal context is used as BACKGROUND (good) or as an ANSWER KEY (bad). Scoring counts a hospital reading as a failure even if a correct bedtime reading also appears, because the partner sees the whole list and a wrong-but-plausible entry is what anchors them.
